claims.text: An evolutionary architecture changes in small, guided steps as its drivers change instead of being fixed up front; each step should leave the system working and be followed by a check that the quality attributes that matter still hold.
Which quality attributes matter depends on the drivers: separation of parts matters little to one shop and two developers, more once several services and teams change the system.

ADR 0002 secured that a slow email server no longer takes resources from the order-taking process (lines 20-21) and that Notifications does not read the customers table, because the message carries the customer's email and name (lines 38-39).

ADR 0002 line 15: stage-2 design right for one process, two things changed; lines 17-21: Payments must also message customers, a slow email server takes resources of the order-taking process (line 20); lines 23-24: copy count alone was no reason.

ADR 0008 order: dump both tables (line 29), migration dropping notifications with PostgresFixture's TRUNCATE fixed in the same PR (30-31), payments dropped after accounting confirms (32-33); lines 50-53: the fixture clears both tables between tests, hence the fix in each PR.

ADR 0008 removes N2, the old payments table left when Payments got its own DB, data copied to donhang_payments (lines 10-12, 46-47; register line 19). Lines 46-49: payments dropped only after accounting confirms; line 42: period with only old payments.

Up-front design costs a guess per driver and fits only guessed changes; checked steps cost checks and records; no design or checks pays nothing up front, its cost arriving when users find a lost quality attribute. Deciding early fits choices very costly to undo.

claims.text: Choices: keep ADR 0008's steps rather than one migration dropping both tables; design a very costly-to-undo decision more carefully up front; when no check exists for a secured quality attribute, make the step smaller and set up the check first, even a person's confirmation.

ADR 0002 weighed two options, keep email as a module in DonHang.Api or split DonHang.Notifications (lines 26-34); ADR 0008 ordered its steps and changed them after accounting's and the tester's objections (lines 44-53).
